title: Lattanzio Group: Excellence in Consultancy-Led Transformation Europe 2025
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html: Lattanzio Group is recognised for translating consultancy insight into transformation, combining strategic rigour with an uncommon capacity to execute at scale across complex public sector environments. Founded with Italian roots yet operating as a global-local organisation, the company has demonstrated disciplined leadership through a multi-year consolidation strategy following several targeted acquisitions, leveraging a KIBS-integrated and distinctive consulting model while preserving cultural coherence and service quality. The company’s strategic approach in acquisitions, coupled with a clear roadmap to resume selective expansion from 2026, evidences maturity and long-term thinking, ensuring geographic growth enhances capability depth rather than diluting expertise. International ambitions across Central Asia, the Arab League countries, North Africa, and the United States are underpinned by established partnerships and a proven ability to adapt solutions to local contexts, reinforcing credibility in global competition. Importantly, Lattanzio Group balances independence with openness to corporate transactions and potential listing, securing capital for growth while safeguarding strategic autonomy. This delivers sustained transformation by fueling long‑term investment, organisational resilience, and trusted advisory leadership across Europe and beyond. The Capital Finance International (CFI.co) Judging Panel congratulates Lattanzio KIBS on winning the 2025 Excellence in Consultancy-Led Transformation Award (Europe).
